conversation_topic: IN-SPIRE servers going down for a bit, back up around 8am

body.text:
I am shutting down the IN-SPIRE servers now for 30ish minutes.

I’m moving the IN-SPIRE servers to the RIE lab in preparation for some vizlab construction starting Monday.  They will be in the RIE lab for about 2 weeks.

Nick
